name: devcut-for-vscode
description: Shows a sponsored line in your status bar while you wait on builds, installs, and tests. You get a share of the revenue.

commands.title: DevCut: Open Website / Get Invite Code
DevCut: Answer Profile Questions (3 quick picks)

devcut.backendUrl.description: Backend URL that serves the current sponsor line and records impressions.

devcut.enabled.description: Show sponsored status bar messages during long-running tasks.

devcut.minTaskSeconds.description: Minimum task duration (seconds) before a sponsored line is shown. Avoids flicker on instant tasks.

devcut.adRotationSeconds.description: Seconds between ad rotations during a long-running task. Each rotation is a new impression.

devcut.idleAdsEnabled.description: Also show sponsored lines while VS Code is idle (window focused, no typing). This is what earns you money while an AI agent works, a build runs in another window, or you read. Idle ads pay a lower rate than build ads, rotate slowly, and disappear the moment you touch the keyboard. Turn it off to only earn during detected builds.

devcut.idleMinutes.description: Minutes of no editor, terminal, or selection activity before idle ads start (minimum 0.5). Defaults to 1 so a normal AI-agent turn is long enough to count. Only applies when devcut.idleAdsEnabled is on.

devcut.idleAdRotationSeconds.description: Seconds between idle ad rotations. Deliberately slower than devcut.adRotationSeconds — idle impressions are low-value and should not be distracting.

devcut.earningsFlashSeconds.description: Seconds the post-task 'Earned ₹X.XX this build' message stays visible before hiding.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node test-tasktypes.js && node server/test-api.js
